test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some B are T.

II. No K is B.

**Conclusion:**

I. No B is K.

II. Some T are B.

III. Some T are K.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows
Both conclusions I and III follows

solution:
As per the given statements, the Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6b5c76edeb56f6203102f941e2b06797ab29622623bbbfbd36f9dc5e551266b.png] 

Conclusion:

I. No B is K. →** Follow** (Because No k is B, which means no B is K)

II. Some T are B. → **Follow** (Because some B are T, which means some T are B)

III. Some T are K. → **Not follow** (Because there is no definite relation between T and K, so it can be possible only)

Hence, the correct answer is** "Both conclusions I and II follow".**
